- 09:05–09:35 — live pairing exercise (pair with Logan)
- 09:35–09:55 — debrief Q&A with panel (Lauren + Elena)

Accessibility notes we received: closed captions requested and a web-only coding environment. Hi Logan — thanks for the details and for checking on accommodations. A couple of small requests: 
1) Can we add a 15-minute buffer before the pairing (09:00 -> 09:15 start) to give me time to set up captions and confirm the web editor?
2) I prefer human captions if available (they're far more reliable for technical terms). If an interpreter is arranged, great — otherwise automated captions are fine.
3) Would it be possible to get a copy of the pairing prompt ahead of time (high-level only)? I understand if you keep the prompt opaque and it's fine either way.

If 09:15 works, I confirm the 09:15–09:45 pairing + 09:45–10:05 debrief. Thanks for being flexible.

Best,
Samir K.
Senior Software Engineer, Gaia Dynamics
